doc.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011

title: Down Beat blindfold test: Roy McCurdy and Sam Jones
summary: Rowe plays a blindfold-style record; Sam recognises Roy McCurdy and Sam Jones on The Sticks.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Cannonball Adderley: the sound, the man, the band

blocks.x: Well did you ever see those old Down Beat where — well they probably still do — they do blindfold tests?
It’s like you’re sitting listening and the guy plays a record and you have to tell what him what it is.
Oh no. But — are you going to do it?
I am going to do it. But you know what?
Oh, a reaction. What I did when I heard that the first time. Roy McCurdy, right? And was it Sam Jones? Sam Jones?
And Nat and like, that’s like one of the greatest moments.
Yeah. That’s the only one I picked out. Because you know I wouldn’t do that good on it. But I know what I know.
